# reroot

The one reading of "this plugin id, after a move": `movedPluginId` and the
reorder entry keys of a config file (`reorderKeyRanges`, `rerootReorderKeys`).
A leaf — it imports only `jsonc-parser` and `plugin-id` — so every reader of a
move shares it without a cycle: `relocate` (its ledger, check and CLI),
`plugin-refs` (`scanReorderItemRefs`) and `config_v2#machine` (the move replay
of a config generation derive, which may not reach build tooling).

## Plugin reference

- Description: A plugin id re-rooted through a move, as a leaf every reader of a move shares: movedPluginId (where an id lands after moving from → to) and, in a config file's text, the plugin-id half of every reorder entry key (`"<pluginId>:<id>"` in an `items` array, at any depth) located by range and re-rooted in place — what the mover, the plugin-refs locator and a backend deriving its config generation all read keys with.
- Core:
  - Uses:
    - `framework/plugin-id.asPluginId`
    - `framework/plugin-id.PluginId`
  - Exports (types): `ReorderKeyRange`
  - Exports (values):
    - `movedPluginId`
    - `reorderKeyRanges`
    - `rerootReorderKeys`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by:
    - `config_v2`
    - `plugin-meta/plugin-refs`
    - `plugin-meta/relocate`
